'''M4-Y7''' was a small [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]].<ref name="May4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The M4-Y7 Astromech Droid was a gift given to all players through their mailbox in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a gift for Star Wars Day on [[May 4]], [[2018]].<ref name="May4" />
